name: comp-324

frames.best_why: Frame 3 shows the four code slots filled with digits, the input state that defines it.

tagline: Popup asks for a four-digit code, then swaps to a verified message.
summary: A trigger opens a dark dialog with four square code slots. Entering the right four digits turns the panel into a Code verified message with a Close button; a wrong code shows an error and a resend link.
appearance: Closed, an outlined OTP code button. Open, a dark rounded dialog with a ring icon, a bold Enter confirmation code heading, a grey hint ending in Try 6548, four square outlined slots in a row and an underlined Resend code link.
behaviour: Typing four digits submits them at once. The right code replaces the slots with Code verified! and a white Close button; a wrong code clears the slots and shows an Invalid code line.
demo_content: Hint says Try 6548; the success state reads Code verified!
use_when: A short emailed code must be entered and checked before continuing.
avoid_when: The expected code is hardcoded in the file, so the check is only a demo.
customise: The correct code, hint and all labels are hardcoded; there are no props and no real verification hook.
weight_why: Four plain slots and one comparison; no animation beyond a focus ring transition.

a11y.note: The error is announced and focus moves to Close on success, but the code field has no accessible name of its own.

issues: The valid code 6548 is hardcoded, so the check is a demo only.
The code slots have no label tying them to the dialog's question.
polish_why: Tidy dialog with clear slots and a real success state; the exposed test code is a demo shortcut.
